text:
Jack Roslovic is on his sixth NHL team, and he might be having his best month. He has 23 points in 24 games for Toronto, and The Leafs Nation's first-quarter grades gave him top marks alongside Auston Matthews through a turbulent start. Toronto's eight-game losing streak is the bigger story; he and Morgan Rielly have even talked about conversations with Rory McIlroy's sports psychologist, per a Daily Faceoff Toronto post.

Some of the pace will fade. He scores 3.30 points per 60, far above our range of 2.00 to 2.79, and has nine goals on 6.3 expected. He also shot 15% last season, so the finishing may be more real than the flag suggests. The play underneath is solid: Toronto is nearly seven points better in expected-goal share with him on the ice than without him.

He is one of the fastest skaters in the league, 99th percentile in top speed with 85 bursts over 20 mph. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking shows how he uses it: 65% of his exits carry possession and 54% of his shots come off the rush. Our numbers project 66 points.
headline: Roslovic is the bright spot in a Leafs skid
